verdict.note: Synced main at 33b064643; Chromium YATU: spec route Alt2->sessions, manual Alt1 dispatch->graph, slash palette, comma settings; graph ArrowDown relation walk, Enter popup, Shift+ArrowDown lens remained open.

Real Chromium, 12/12. From #/spec/spexcode: ⌥N→#/sessions/new, ⌥F→#/evals, ⌥/ and bare / both open the palette, ',' →#/settings. ⌥1..⌥5 all leave the hash at #/spec/spexcode — the positional page row is gone from the registry, so the shell answers no digit. Graph: click .plugins → ArrowDown walks to 'extensions', Enter opens the .ov-panel popup, Shift+ArrowDown walks THROUGH it to 'plugin-system' with the popup still mounted (lens intact). Tabs: with 4 held, ⌥⇧← / ⌥⇧→ select previous/next and ⌥⇧X closes the active one (4→3); Ctrl+R remains the browser's. One capture listener, no view-owned global dispatch.
